query:
UPDATE people SET
            name = COALESCE($2, name),
            sort_name = COALESCE($3, sort_name),
            identifiers = identifiers || $4,
            images = images || $5,
            bio = COALESCE($6, bio),
            birth_date = COALESCE($7, birth_date),
            death_date = COALESCE($8, death_date),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
